question: If cot 18° = (p)/(q), then the value of (cosec² 378^circ)/(1+tan²378^circ) is
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Reduce the angle to the first quadrant: 378° = 360° + 18°. The expression becomes cosec² 18° / (1 + tan² 18°). Using 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, it simplifies to cosec² 18° / sec² 18°. Since cosec θ / sec θ = cot θ, the entire expression strictly reduces to cot² 18°. Substitute cot 18° = p/q directly to get (p/q)² = p²/q². **∴ The correct answer is p²/q².**
